text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A at large gains felt rewarding, but I should base future sales on my plan and risk limits, not the pleasure of locking in a profit.","My account fell in the last two periods after earlier gains; short-term swings can reverse, so I should judge decisions by a longer horizon rather than recent results.","After adding to Stocks B, D and E, my account declined; I should keep positions diversified and sized carefully, and avoid assuming any purchase will quickly recover."]}
